meta.title: Person or Role Assignment: refused for a user without the Tenant Admin role
gaps: Sign in as a user without the Tenant Admin role
Locate and perform Person or Role Assignment to assign steps to a person or role
Repeat the action as a Tenant Admin
Compare the refused or absent action for the non-admin with its availability for the Tenant Admin
Record tenant RBAC configuration when additional roles are deliberately granted this capability
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Sign in as a user without the Tenant Admin role; Locate and perform Person or Role Assignment to assign steps to a person or role; Repeat the action as a Tenant Admin; Compare the refused or absent action for the non-admin with its availability for the Tenant Admin; Record tenant RBAC configuration when additional roles are deliberately granted this capability

args.need: sign in as a non-Tenant-Admin user, test whether Person or Role Assignment is refused or absent, then repeat the same action as a Tenant Admin in the same tenant and compare the results

steps.note: No catalog step can access the required user roles or observe the Person or Role Assignment control and outcome.
Verify the session is not showing a crash or server error after the tester's role-assignment checks.
